SELECT MIN(prc), MAX(prc), AVG(prc), SUM(CASE WHEN prc > 50 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS over50 FROM items_g1 WHERE prc IS NOT NULL

SELECT ROUND(AVG(f.rtg), 4) AS avg_rating,
       COUNT(*) AS n_reviews,
       COUNT(DISTINCT f.ref_id) AS n_items
FROM fdbk_g1 f
JOIN items_g1 i ON f.ref_id = i.ref_id
WHERE i.prc > 50
